steps.title: Pick a design
steps.text: Choose an opening. You can try it before you create an account.

steps.title: Add your details
steps.text: Names, functions, photos and music. The preview updates as you type.

steps.title: Publish and share
steps.text: Publish, then send one link. Guests open it in the browser.

features: They open one link. No app and no account.
Each function can have its own time, place and dress.
Replies come back on the same invitation.

faqs.q: Do my guests need an app or an account?
faqs.a: No. Guests open your link in any browser and RSVP in one tap. It works on basic phones too.

faqs.q: Can I design before signing up?
faqs.a: Yes. Pick a template and customise it as a guest. We only ask you to log in when you publish, and your draft comes with you.

faqs.q: Can different guests see different functions?
faqs.a: Yes. Put guests into groups and choose which functions each group sees.
Pages can be password-protected, and the address can stay hidden until a guest says yes.
Yes. Every guest sees the latest version through the same link.
